related_questions.question: How many times am I going to get COVID?
related_questions.snippet: Reinfection with the virus that causes COVID-19 occurs when you are infected, recover, and then get infected again. You can get reinfected multiple times. Staying up to date on vaccines and seeking treatment for a COVID-19 infection can help decrease the risk of experiencing severe illness.

related_questions.question: Can you find out if you had COVID?
related_questions.snippet: Need to Know? Get an Antibodies Test. Antibodies are proteins your body makes to help fight off an infection. The only way to know for certain if you've had COVID-19 is to have your blood tested to see if you have the antibodies that fight the virus.
